frame.get_async_key_state: every frame-phase call answers 0 (not pressed, no transition)

provenance.async_keys: no human input: every frame-phase GetAsyncKeyState answers 0
provenance.caller_registers: declared saved ECX/EDX in ProgIteration's frame and carried ESI/EDI/EBP of _WinMain@16 (never executed by the bench); influence measured by the sensitivity run
provenance.cursor: GetCursorPos answer. Equals the last SetCursorPos target of the accepted path (CalculGame 0x42c89e passes the words at 0x5099a8/0x5099aa, which ProgIteration fills from GetCursorPos); Windows keeps the cursor there when the mouse does not move
provenance.peek_message: no human input and no window message: PeekMessageA answers 0, so _WinMain@16 takes the active-flag branch to ProgIteration

provenance.allocation_fill: declared initial byte of non-ZEROINIT GlobalAlloc memory (Windows leaves GMEM_FIXED contents unspecified)
provenance.async_keys: Enter pressed/released on the default item of menus 2 and 3, then Enter on the research screen (no research branch click)
provenance.clock_ms: declared timeGetTime value consumed by iaRandom(0) in IaAlloc; real value is nondeterministic, every value is an original execution
provenance.install_directory: WINSTALL.INF TemplateTargetDir=RISING under drive C: (installer default); machine-specific, used only to build profile/data paths
provenance.memory_status: 32 zero bytes; consumed only as the GlobalCompact argument
provenance.thread_id: stored only in CRT thread data +0xda

phases.stop_routine: bench caller trampoline (load-state CalculGame called by the bench, as in M1)

untouched.note: POINT local (rewritten by GetCursorPos before any read) and _WinMain@16 MSG buffer keep the bench stack bytes; reads are measured by the footprint

words.provenance: ProgIteration saved EBX (push ebx 0x47500e): _WinMain@16 EBX is 0 from 0x4601af
